name: SikaFuko® VT-1
tagline: Re-injectable hose for sealing construction joints
summary: SikaFuko® VT-1 is a re-injectable hose for sealing various construction and connection joints in watertight concrete structures. To seal the joint, SikaFuko® VT-1 is injected with suitable Sika® Injection materials, such as acrylate and microfine cement suspensions (for multiple injections) or polyurethane and epoxy resins (for single injection). With the integrated ‘valve techniques’ the hose can be used to re-inject multiple times if necessary.

items.label: Composition
items.text:
Yellow inner core | PVC
Yellow profile strips | Neoprene based cellular rubber
Mesh | Polyester

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Always refer to packaging.

items.label: Diameter
items.text:
Internal hose diameter | 6 mm
External hose diameter | 13,5 mm

items.label: System structure
items.text:
A | Injection channel
B | Solid hose core made of high quality PVC compound
C | Lateral grooves with staggered injection openings
D | Compressible neoprene profile strips (as ‘valves’) over the longitudinal grooves
E | Fine webbed nylon mesh for secure fixing of the neoprene profiles

items.label: Shore A hardness
items.text:
Yellow inner core | 85 ±3
Yellow profile strips | 20 ±5

items.label: Elongation
items.text:
Yellow inner core | ≥ 250 %
Yellow profile strips | ≥ 300 %
Mesh | ≥ 30 %

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text: Concrete surface must be clean and all loose materials removed before installing hose and placing concrete.

rel.t: Polyacrylic elastic injection resin for permanent watertight sealing
rel.s: Sika® Injection-306 is a very low viscous, elastic polyacrylic injection resin with a versatile and adjustable reaction time which can be used in ground water protection zones.
a: Provides a passivating environment for embedded steel reinforcement
Adjustable curing time between 10 and 60 minutes
Permanently elastic, can absorb limited movement
Capable of reversibly absorbing (swelling) and releasing (shrinking) moisture
Very low viscosity comparable to water
